statement: MediaTek expects AI datacenter ASIC revenue to exceed $2 billion in 2026, with its first ASIC entering production in Q4 2026 developed with major US cloud service provider customers.
why: Revenue at this scale from a new custom-ASIC entrant, tied to named hyperscaler customers, measures how much accelerator spend is moving to non-GPU silicon.

impact.mechanism: A challenger's first-generation ASIC reaching production for US cloud providers adds alternative accelerator supply and diverts part of the hyperscaler accelerator budget away from merchant GPUs.

evidence.excerpt: AI datacenter ASIC revenue expected to exceed $2 billion in 2026
major US cloud service provider customers

confidence.basis: Secondary trade coverage of an earnings call; corroborated by the Investing.com transcript of the same call, which is one event and not three independent publishers.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 1 -> 2; sources: Runpod, The Register
